bullets: ROC is a graph showing the performance of a classification model at all classification thresholds.
This curve plots two parameters: [1] True Positive Rate    [2] False Positive Rate
True Positive Rate (TPR) is a synonym for recall and is therefore defined as:
Correctly Predicted as Positive / ALL Actual Positive Samples
False Positive Rate (FPR) is defined as:
Incorrectly Predicted as Positive / ALL Actual Negative Samples
(Error percentage in samples Predicted as Positive)
An ROC curve plots TPR vs. FPR at different classification thresholds.
